prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 25 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1011; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Objective tests go against the complaints: imaging is normal and the patient moved freely when observed outside the exam room.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a sideswipe collision during a lane change, reporting neck and low back pain with associated stiffness. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported symptoms and the force of the impact. No prior injury to the cervical or lumbar regions is documented in the available history. Care consisted of 25 visits including manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home exercise instruction. Frequency of visits decreased steadily as symptoms improved, and the course of treatment followed a typical progression for soft tissue strain. Imaging of the cervical and lumbar spine was reported as normal. On examination, range of motion and clinical findings were limited relative to the patient's stated complaints, and the patient was observed moving with greater freedom outside the examination room than during formal testing. Billing records reflect single charges for each service without duplication. Discharge plan includes continued self-directed exercise and follow-up as needed.
